description: Pure-Python parsers and unit-aware plotters for computational chemistry outputs: eOn NEB/min/saddle, ORCA, ChemGP, PLUMED. Sibling of rgpycrumbs and pychum.
rules: Import from chemparseplot (parse and plot public API). Do not reach into private _modules.
Parsers return structured objects; plotters are unit-aware. See https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/ .
Sibling packages: rgpycrumbs (CLI / surfaces / viz dispatch) and pychum (input generation).
Org prose lives under docs/orgmode/; committed Markdown tutorials under doc/source/tutorials/.
